absmean_quant.equation: (map a0 (max (min (round (/ (idx a0 item1) (max (/ (fold (range 0 (len a0)) 0 (+ acc2.0 (abs (idx a0 item2)))) (len a0)) 1e-05f))) 1) -1))

clock_read.equation: (fold (range 0 105) -1 (sel (and (== acc1.0 -1) (and (== (% item1 3) a0) (and (== (% item1 5) a1) (== (% item1 7) a2)))) item1 acc1.0))

crt2.equation: (fold (range 0 (* a1 a3)) -1 (sel (and (== acc1.0 -1) (and (== (% item1 a1) a0) (== (% item1 a3) a2))) item1 acc1.0))

softmax.equation: (map a0 (/ (exp (- (idx a0 item1) (maxall a0))) (fold (range 0 (len a0)) 0 (+ acc2.0 (exp (- (idx a0 item2) (maxall a0)))))))

period.equation: (fold (range 1 (+ (len a0) 1)) 0 (sel (and (== acc1.0 0) (fold (range 0 (- (len a0) item1)) 1 (sel (== (idx a0 item2) (idx a0 (+ item2 item1))) acc2.0 0))) item1 acc1.0))
